description: Harden the POKER-DATA-SCHEMA-001 persistence candidate per independent review/audit findings: enforce action-to-seated-player provenance with a composite foreign key, close the UPDATE-path gap in card-disjointness triggers, declare the runtime/dependency contract in pyproject.toml, and add fail-to-pass negatives for the batch-lineage foreign keys.
acceptance_criteria: An action can only attribute to a player actually seated at that (hand_id, seat_number): composite FK actions(hand_id, seat_number, player_id) -> hand_players(hand_id, seat_number, player_id) is enforced and a negative fail-to-pass test rejects a mismatched player.
Card-disjointness is enforced on both INSERT and UPDATE of hole_cards and board_cards, with negative fail-to-pass tests for the UPDATE path.

The runtime contract is declared in pyproject.toml (requires Python >= 3.12; pinned sqlalchemy 2.1.3 and alembic 1.20.0) consistent with ADR-0002, and a new ADR records the provenance and migration decisions.
Fail-to-pass negative tests exist for import_batches.raw_source_id and hands.import_batch_id foreign keys.
Deterministic schema recreation, alembic/create_all parity, and the full suite (prior 658 tests plus new tests) remain green.

source_evidence: .harness/runs/POKER-DATA-SCHEMA-001/handoffs/reviewer.json (medium findings: action player-to-seat pairing, UPDATE-path trigger gap, undeclared Python 3.12 floor, portable-SQL note)
.harness/runs/POKER-DATA-SCHEMA-001/handoffs/test-auditor.json (medium finding: import_batches.raw_source_id and hands.import_batch_id lack negative tests)
origin.user_authorization: Explicit user instruction in orchestrator session to proceed with the follow-up hardening work

planning.title: Harden DB schema provenance, UPDATE triggers, runtime contract, and FK negatives
planning.notes: Initial migration may be edited in place because the project is pre-release and AC1 of POKER-DATA-SCHEMA-001 pins deterministic empty-database recreation; the decision must be journaled in ADR-0004. pyproject.toml is a declaration only: no build backend, no dependency installation, no packaging metadata beyond [project] name/version/requires-python/dependencies.
